content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Gumroad and similar platforms offer a simplistic approach to selling digital products, but at a steep cost: 10% of every sale goes to the platform. In contrast, solutions like COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack offer a comprehensive, crypto-enabled ecommerce stack with automatic payment processing and instant product delivery, all without the hefty fees. This difference in approach can save creators $921 on just 100 sales of a $97 product, a significant retention of earnings.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed and fees associated with traditional platforms can be crippling. Gumroad's 10% fee, for example, eats into creator earnings significantly. NOWPayments, on the other hand, charges a mere 0.5% fee, with no KYC requirements and support for over 300 cryptocurrencies. This drastic reduction in fees, combined with fast transaction processing on networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, makes for a much more viable option for digital creators.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks reduce fees by up to 95% compared to traditional platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of a sovereign digital commerce stack is the level of control and ownership it affords creators. With COREMERCH, once the stack is deployed, the creator owns everything, with no ongoing subscriptions or dependencies on third-party platforms. Automated delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script ensures that products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation, further streamlining the sales process.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators looking to sell digital products with crypto, the choice of architecture depends on their specific needs and restrictions. Those in restricted countries or seeking to minimize fees may find COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack particularly appealing. The key is selecting an infrastructure that prioritizes sovereignty, low fees, and accessibility, ensuring that creators can focus on what matters most: producing and selling their digital products.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack using solutions like COREMERCH. This approach not only bypasses traditional platform restrictions but also significantly reduces fees, with NOWPayments charging only 0.5% per transaction. By owning your infrastructure, you gain full control over your sales process and can sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products directly to your audience, worldwide.
Crypto payments via NOWPayments support over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee.

For those interested in building a comprehensive digital commerce infrastructure, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, providing everything needed to deploy and scale a sovereign stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore this and other solutions designed to help creators thrive in a platform-agnostic world.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting your hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and choose a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Then, configure your automatic payment processing with NOWPayments, and finally, test your stack end-to-end to ensure seamless product delivery. With these steps, you can establish a robust, fee-efficient infrastructure for selling digital products with crypto.
